series_name: Pokémon the Series: Gold and Silver
title: Pokémon the Series: Gold and Silver
synopsis: The series follows the adventures of the ten-year-old Pokémon Trainer Ash Ketchum and his electric-type mouse partner Pikachu as they collect Gym Badges in the fictional Johto region so they can compete in the Johto Pokémon League competition. This series includes Johto Journeys, Johto League Champions & Master Quest arcs
